library: stb_image.h (nothings/stb) — the canonical widely-copied single-file C image loader
note: Each fix below is a real security/overflow hardening stb introduced over time. A copy either contains the introduced symbol (has the fix) or does not (stale). Presence/absence is checked in the copy's own bytes. The commit API being down for nothings/stb blocks automated mining of the full history; this curated set is the pilot, and mitos/benchmark.py scales to any number of fixes.

fixes.desc: short multiply overflow check (JPEG merge dc/ac)
